plan: I’ll restrict the analysis to the supplied mean-phase scan and keep the spread scan separate. The script will report observed Stokes and DOP summaries, squared Stokes norm, and the difference between the directions at the two phase endpoints. It will compare constant, low-order Fourier, and linear-phase descriptions using contiguous held-out phase blocks, treating the results as exploratory prediction metrics rather than significance tests. It will omit acquisition-order modeling because the file does not establish that row order represents acquisition order. These single-scan measurements cannot establish repeatability or distinguish phase locking from drift or hysteresis; the proposed discriminating follow-up is repeated, randomized and reversed sweeps.
